items.label: Large Countertop Space
items.value: The 70.9-inch wide countertop provides a spacious surface to prepare drinks, serve snacks or display decorations. You can easily place multiple cocktail shakers, glasses and ingredients on it without feeling crowded

items.label: Spacious 4-Tier Design
items.value: This bar table features 4-tier storage space with multiple compartments, providing ample space to place your wine glasses, glassware, bar accessories and other necessities, allowing for easy access while enabling neat organization

items.label: Comfortable Footrest Design
items.value: The black metal footrest not only adds a touch of sophistication to the tribesigns home bar unit, but also provides a comfortable place for people sitting at the bar to rest their feet, allowing them to enjoy a drink more relaxedly

items.label: Modern and Stylish Aesthetics
items.value: The tribesigns bar table features a smooth wood finish and black footrest; the combination of the two further enhances the visual experience and can be seamlessly integrated into any home, pub, patio or basement

items.label: Stable and Sturdy Structure
items.value: Made of high-quality wood, this bar unit has an enduring structure that can support the weight of various items without sagging or shaking. It is suitable for both residential and commercial use, from home to busy bar
